summary: Prolonged initial token latency on chat after model-compatibility-layer deploy
description:
Issue summary:
VertexAI Labs reported an increase in time-to-first-token (TTFB) for chat completions after the deployment of the model-compatibility shim (compat-layer v2.1.0) on 2026-03-09. Impact is visible for both interactive chat sessions and API single-request completions.

Impact:
- Intermittent 300-900ms additional latency before first token across ~8% of requests for the customer's dedicated pool.
- Customers observed streaming stalls and reconnects in 1-2% of sessions.
- Affects SLAs for dedicated tier customers and causes degraded UX for VertexAI Labs product.

Timeline:
- 2026-03-09 03:20 UTC: Compat-layer v2.1.0 rolled to dedicated serving pool (canary -> gradual).
- 2026-03-09 04:05 UTC: First customer report via support channel.
- 2026-03-10: Multiple customers report elevated TTFB; engineering triaged.

Environment:
- Dedicated capacity (customer pinned to rwd-open-llama-13B-q4 on prod us-east).
- Serving runtime 1.9.4; compat-layer v2.1.0; kernel-selection pipeline unchanged.

Additional notes:
- Issue surfaced primarily on cold requests and short prompts, suggesting cache/prefix invalidation or added per-request compute in the request path.
